PM/GM at LEO Innovation LabTREAT
TREAT, an app addressing underlying causes of inflammatory conditions through personalised nutrition advice, delivered as a decision-tree chatbot with nutritionists behind it. LEO Innovation Lab's first and flagship product.		The flagship had a lot of attention and was in trouble behind the scenes: massive tech debt, no prioritisation, flaky metrics, no roadmap, unclear reporting structure, massive churn, no pathway to profitability. An existing team of about 15, including a product lead and a product manager, passionate but in over their heads.Parachuted in with a 6-month mandate to stabilise it and assess viability.Everything was on fire. Let some things burn and watched long enough to see which big patterns were broken, then started at the top of the funnel and worked through. Paused the service to refactor faster. Defined the value proposition and put KPIs into the daily workflow so the team steered by numbers. Set an experiment-led rhythm. Two levers: finding the fit before sign-up, and finding the fit inside the product.Halved customer acquisition costs. Increased activation 7x.
